text.tspan: 1. When moving an object with the rotation set to zero,
for some reason that object gets weird rendering when moving it around (with G) but it's fine when rotating it or scaling it.
2. When making a symbol that has booleans (masks) and then trying to use it as an "erase" mask, the objects that
were supposed to be just masks suddenly unify and erase OUT of the zone where they're supposed to be seen, or not seen at all.
